newsitem.title: USA: Group AB IPO launched in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Group AB IPO launched in heavy trade.

text.p: The initial public offering of French television producer Groupe AB SA was launched in heavy trade on Thursday in New York.
By midday volume was 2.97 million shares to rank among leaders on the New York Stock Exchange. The stock's price was unchanged at 21.

Groupe AB was offering 11.2 million American Depositary Receipts representing 5.6 million ordinary shares. Of the ordinary shares being offered, 4.45 million are being sold by Groupe AB and 1.15 million by three of the company's shareholders.

Groupe AB creates, develops, produces and buys television programming which it distributes mainly in France and French-speaking regions in Europe. The company plans to launch, by the end of this year, a direct-to-home digital satellite offering of 18 channels.
Managing underwriters of the offering are Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette and Morgan Stanley Co.
